name: alps
description: Design or simplify the Process Description that turns recurring agent work into a reusable Process Skill.

interface.longDescription: ALPS provides one Skill for designing or simplifying the authoritative Process Description behind recurring agent work. It clarifies Purpose, observable Outcomes, a reusable boundary, and only the detail needed for correct and assessable use.
capabilities: Design a Process Description from recurring work
Revise a Process Description from evidence of use
defaultPrompt: Turn this recurring work into a Process Description with one Purpose, observable Outcomes, and a reusable boundary.
Simplify this Process Skill to the minimum detail needed for correct and assessable use.
Revise this Process Description using the attached results, failures, ambiguities, and unresolved assumptions.
